scope: Complete three-page DatesTutorial: all 36 native TMP memberships, six full wording units. Russian owner-reported display repair, no global source/release gate waiver.
context: Player male, informal ты. Critter=зверушка. Date=свидание optional social/story encounter. Maverick=Маверик, shop owner. Preserve promiscuity/adult flirty tone, occasional pairs at shop, conversation, time/quest/gossip unlocks, multi-meet stories and temporary quest/gossip unavailability. Targets title reused from ornamental v055; grammar adaptation allowed in explanatory prose.

rows.source: <size=22>C</size>RITTER <size=22>D</size>ATES
rows.target: <size=22>С</size>ВИДАНИЯ <size=22>З</size>ВЕРУШЕК

rows.source: When critters are “on a date” – They won’t be able to do Quests, OR gossips. You will need to locate them in their normal locations for that. Besides… it would be quite rude to bother them during their date!
rows.target: Во время свидания зверушки не дают заданий и не делятся слухами. Для этого ищи их в обычных местах. Да и мешать им на свидании было бы невежливо!

rows.source: The Critters of the area are inspired by your promiscuity! Occasionally, critters will show up in pairs by Maverick’s Shop and be hanging out! Be sure to talk with them and see how they are doing!
rows.target: Зверушек вдохновили твои любовные похождения! Иногда у магазина Маверика можно встретить парочки. Поговори с ними и узнай, как у них дела!
